newsitem.title: USA: ARCO unit cleared to develop oil field.
newsitem.headline: ARCO unit cleared to develop oil field.

text.p: The Ecuadorian Ministry of Energy and Mines issued a decree clearing the way for ARCO Oriente Inc and its partner Agip Petroleum (Ecuador) Ltd, a unit of Agip SpA, to begin development of the Villano oil field in eastern Ecuador, ARCO said.
ARCO Oriente Inc is a subsidiary of Los Angeles-based ARCO.

The decree authorizes modifications to ARCO/Agip's existing development plan to include the construction of a 130 kilometer (81 mile) secondary pipeline to take oil from the planned Villano field processing facilities to the Transecuadorian Pipeline System.
These modifications were agreed in June 1996, but needed ministerial authorization to proceed, ARCO said.

Detailed engineering and environmental impact studies for both the pipeline and oil field development will be completed over the next six to seven months and the pipeline will be operative by 1999, ARCO said.
